description: Set a human-readable name for a game (the `game` argument, else the x-mp-game header, else your only game). The name shows in your dashboard: call this when you start building so the game isn't unnamed. Refuses to guess when the studio has several games and none was named.

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

name: set_game_name
title: Name a game
